ID_SNACKBAR_LOADOUT_INCOMPATIBLE.Note: Max chars limit: 24 Title of the Snackbar notification when player has currently an incompatible Loadout selected (Free Loadout in this case) when the Squad leader selects a map and/or the final check before queuing players is happening. We keep in general so in the future, we can utilize this notification for potentially other requirements.  This text might also appear in the footer bar as status indicator to the affected player.

ID_SNACKBAR_LOADOUT_UNAVAILABLE.Note: Max chars limit: 24 Alternative phrasing for incompatible - corresponds to the characterized description in the map condition. Though this might be a bit too specific, refering to a "full loadout" (e.g. the Free Loadout) being unavailable, but wouldn't be usable if we ever refer to other loadout requirements.

ID_SNACKBAR_CHANGE_LOADOUT.Note: Max chars limit: 20 Action description on Snackbar notification, as well as potentially an action in the Matchmaking footer bar.  Upon interaction, the affected player with incompatible loadout will be deeplinked into the Loadout selection, where they have their previously configured Custom Loadout reinstated.

ID_SNACKBAR_SERVER_CHANGE.Note: This would be for a snackbar notification in case the party leader changes their server. It would inform squad members briefly that the destinations updated as a consequence. We might not have this, so this is just for the case we feel like we need this

ID_SNACKBAR_SERVER_DESTINATIONS_UPDATED.Note: The consequence that players are experiencing after the server change or even when joining a party with a leader in a different region. The map screen refreshes, and of course there's a regional indicator we show, but party members might be in other parts of the game, so it might be nice to inform them on the update. Not 100% sure if we will have this.
